_comment: Hand-curated Sirsa demo rules citing pages that exist in HAR16-Sirsa-30-06-2011.pdf (31 pages). Loaded as drafts, validated, then approved via ReviewService — never inserted as approved. Do not confuse with sirsa_dacp.json, whose citations (pp. 37–44) are out of range and are kept only as invariant fixtures.

fields.farming_situation: Light textured sandy soils susceptible to wind erosion
fields.condition: Normal onset followed by 15-20 days dry spell after sowing leading to poor germination/crop stand etc.
fields.action: Re-sow when rains resume if plant population is below two-thirds; gap-fill by transplanting under rainy conditions.

fields.action: Don't grow clusterbean beyond mid-August; keep listed pearl millet / intercrop options.

fields.farming_situation: Light textured sandy soils susceptible to wind erosion
fields.condition: Early season drought (normal onset) — rainless period at vegetative stage
fields.action: Weeding and hoeing; thinning to reduce 1/3 population; life-saving irrigation of 4-5 cm if possible.
